title: Barbecue Bourbon Bloody Mary Recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 25ml of bourbon whiskey, preferably Wild Turkey
1 slice of grilled bacon, to garnish
ldInstructionsRaw: Add all of the ingredients (except the celery and bacon) to a cocktail shaker and shake to combine
Pour into a high ball tumbler to serve. Wrap the cooked bacon around the celery stick (you may need to secure it with a toothpick) and use to garnish
